# ClipForge — Free On-Device Video, Audio & Photo Studio

> ClipForge is a bright, privacy-first browser media studio that runs video, audio, and photo tools locally inside the browser using FFmpeg WebAssembly, Web Audio API, HTML5 Canvas, and on-device ONNX AI models. No file uploads, no mandatory sign-up.

## Studio Directory
- [ClipForge Home — All 9 Browser Media Tools](https://clipforge.vercel.app/): Browse and search all video, audio, and photo tools.

## Video Tools
- [Compress Video to Size](https://clipforge.vercel.app/tools/compress-video): Shrink MP4, MOV, or WebM videos to exact MB targets (8MB Discord, 16MB WhatsApp, 25MB Email, Custom MB) locally via FFmpeg.wasm.
- [Video Trimmer & Cutter](https://clipforge.vercel.app/tools/trim-video): Instant lossless stream-copy or frame-accurate H.264 video cutting right in your browser.
- [MP4 to Animated GIF](https://clipforge.vercel.app/tools/mp4-to-gif): Two-pass custom color palette GIF conversion with custom FPS and width.
- [MOV & WebM to MP4 Converter](https://clipforge.vercel.app/tools/video-converter): Convert MOV, WebM, and MKV clips to universal H.264 MP4 with 9:16, 1:1, and 16:9 social presets.

## Audio Tools
- [Extract or Mute Audio](https://clipforge.vercel.app/tools/extract-audio): Extract 192 kbps MP3 or lossless WAV audio from video, or strip audio losslessly.
- [Audio Cutter & Volume Booster](https://clipforge.vercel.app/tools/audio-cutter): Live waveform scrubber, smooth fade-in/out, volume boost up to 300%, MP3/WAV export.
- [Audio to Waveform Video](https://clipforge.vercel.app/tools/audio-to-video): Animated audiogram video generator for Reels (9:16), Square (1:1), and Landscape (16:9).

## Photo Tools
- [AI Background Remover](https://clipforge.vercel.app/tools/background-remover): On-device neural background removal with transparent PNG and studio backdrop export.
- [Image Studio & Compress to KB](https://clipforge.vercel.app/tools/image-studio): Batch JPG/PNG/WebP conversion, EXIF/GPS stripping, exact-KB binary search compression (50KB/100KB/200KB), and ZIP download.
- [Passport & ID Photo Maker](https://clipforge.vercel.app/tools/passport-photo): Official India/UK/EU, US, and Canada 300 DPI sizing with face alignment guide and 4x6 printable sheet.
- [Blur & Redact Photo](https://clipforge.vercel.app/tools/blur-redact): Irreversible Canvas blur, pixelate, and solid black-box redaction with automatic EXIF/GPS metadata stripping.

## Pricing
- Free Tier: Free on-device processing with zero cloud uploads.
- ClipForge Pro Annual Plan: $29/year (billed annually, cancel anytime) — unlocks unlimited batch ZIPs, 4K exports, watermark-free waveform videos, and 300 DPI 4x6 printable passport sheets.
